intro.text: An attendant of the Arelene court who meets Sarene when she arrives in Kae.

items.text: Sent by King Iadon to greet Sarene, Ketol broke the news of Raoden's supposed death. He objected when she asked to see the casket, having been told to bring her straight to the king, but gave way, cleared a path to it with some packmen, and then took her to court and coached her on how to approach the king.

appearance.text: Tall and gaunt, with a bored look.

personality.text: He does his job well, but without any enthusiasm.
